vanilla.englishText: {SALUTATION}...
{STR_SALUTATION}. It's been a while.
So, then. What is it?
Is there anything else?
Until next time, then.
Do you have any orders for your alley, {?CONVERSATION_NPC.GENDER}madam{?}sir{\?}
Yes?
What role do you have in mind?
Very well.
I would be honored.
I already have quite a few duties. Perhaps you could relieve me of one of them, so that I can take on this new responsibility?
I have a mission for you...
What do you want me to do?
As you wish. Will I take some troops with me?
As you wish.
What? Why? Did I do something wrong?[ib:closed]
Well... I don't know what to say. Goodbye, then.[ib:nervous2]
Well {PLAYER.NAME}, it is certainly good to see you still retain your sense of humor.[if:convo_nervous][ib:normal2]
I would be honored, my {?PLAYER.GENDER}lady{?}lord{\?}. But I can't take on any new responsibilities while leading this caravan. If you wish to relieve me of my duties, we can discuss this further.

Thank you, my {?PLAYER.GENDER}lady{?}lord{\?}. I have often thought about that. If I had a fief, with revenues, and perhaps a title to go with it, I could marry well and pass my wealth down to my heirs, and of course raise troops to help defend the realm.
My {?PLAYER.GENDER}lady{?}lord{\?}, as much as I appreciate the gesture, I am not sure that you have a suitable estate to grant me.
As you wish, my {?PLAYER.GENDER}lady{?}lord{\?}.
Where exactly did you have in mind?[if:convo_happy]
{SETTLEMENT_NAME}? This is a great honor, my {?PLAYER.GENDER}lady{?}lord{\?}. I will protect it until the last drop of my blood.[ib:hip][if:convo_happy]
My {?PLAYER.GENDER}lady{?}lord{\?}, it would be an honor if you were to choose the name of my noble house.
Thank you my {?PLAYER.GENDER}lady{?}lord{\?}. I will always remember this grand gesture.[ib:hip][if:convo_happy]
It's only normal that you have second thoughts. I will be right by your side if you change your mind, my {?PLAYER.GENDER}lady{?}lord{\?}.
{TITLE}, there is something I wish to discuss with you.
{TITLE}... {GRIEVANCE_SHORT_DESCRIPTION}
I don't like running away from a battle like that.
I should remind you that I expect to be paid as you had promised.
I hear we're running low on food. We should watch our stocks better.
Pillaging villages is not what I signed up for.
{SALUTATION}... Thank you for freeing me.
What now?
All right. It's good to be back.
Tell me who to command.
I will go off on my own, then. I can stay busy. But I'll remember - I owe you one!
As you wish.
So, what shall I do?
We'll make ready to set out at once.
{SALUTATION}... You came for me!
I'm ready to rejoin you. I'm in your debt.
Lead the way.
I shall do that.
As you wish.
